verdict.rationale: Apple's Mac User Guide documents a built-in automation tool, Shortcuts, under the heading "Automate tasks with Shortcuts", which matches the story directly. A community user also describes chaining the built-in pbcopy/pbpaste command-line tools in the terminal to automate a repetitive cleanup task. The first-party evidence is only a heading, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of Shortcuts' capabilities (actions, triggers, scheduling, other scripting options), and independent hands-on corroboration of automating tasks with Shortcuts.
